content.short: Kuru is a high-performance CLOB DEX on Monad providing a CEX-like trading experience and deep liquidity fully on-chain.
content.description: Kuru is a pioneering decentralized exchange built natively on the Monad blockchain, designed to offer a professional-grade trading experience with sub-second finality. Unlike traditional AMMs, Kuru utilizes a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) architecture, providing the tight spreads and limit order functionality typically found on centralized exchanges. By leveraging Monad's parallel execution and high throughput, Kuru delivers near-instant trade execution and deep liquidity. The platform also features "Kuru Flow," a smart liquidity aggregator that unifies liquidity across Monad.
content.meta: Kuru offers professional-grade on-chain order book trading and liquidity aggregation on Monad. Explore Kuru and DeFi dApps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
